heading: The Marginarium: how it was made
first_line: Paul Bordjadze directs a small team of AI agents; the Marginarium's chapters tell how this app gets made.
content_why: One passage and one picture per chapter lets visitors taste each story without the README becoming a book, and the full stories are not on GitHub yet.
avoid: Avoid implying the agents work unsupervised or the Lamp decides alone, since Paul has the last word and the chapters say Claude and Codex also make many taste calls.
